evidence.title: gooey-toast — Morphing toast notifications for React

name: gooey-toast
summary: Morphing blob toast notifications for React, built on Sonner with Framer Motion animations.
description: Demo and docs site for a React toast component whose notifications morph from a pill into an organic blob, with promise tracking and full customization. Ships five toast types, six positions, animation presets, dark mode and RTL support; installed via the shadcn CLI or as the goey-toast npm package.
contains: gooey-toast React component, installable via shadcn CLI or npm
five toast types: default, success, error, warning, info
promise toasts with loading to success/error transitions
six positions, dark mode and RTL support, swipe to dismiss
animation presets: smooth, bouncy, subtle, snappy
ships an Agent Skill (SKILL.md) for coding agents
built on Sonner with Framer Motion; MIT licensed
